top tb.shbench for Ngspice
== cap.shprim
schemify 1 shprim
  doc "Capacitor (run fixture)"
  prefix C
  vsym 4b1ffa204463a9d5

pin A inout 0 -30
pin B inout 0 30

param C 1p
  unit F

impl spice spice
  format spice "{name} {A} {B} {C}"

line 0 -30 0 -4
line 0 4 0 30
line -12 -4 12 -4
line -12 4 12 4

stext 16 -12 R0 {name}
  size 0.2
stext 16 2 R0 C={eng(C)}
  size 0.18
== res.shprim
schemify 1 shprim
  doc "Resistor (run fixture)"
  prefix R
  vsym 3b32237a5945e7a3

pin A inout 0 -30
pin B inout 0 30

param R 1k
  unit Ohm

impl spice spice
  format spice "{name} {A} {B} {R}"

line 0 -30 0 -15
line 0 15 0 30

rect -5 -15 5 15

stext 10 -12 R0 {name}
  size 0.2
stext 10 2 R0 R={eng(R)}
  size 0.18
== schemify.project
schemify 1 project
== tb.shbench

  vmaefile maestro.sdb text "<?xml version=\"1.0\"?>\n<setupdb version=\"6\">maestro\n\t<active>Active Setup\n\t\t<corners>\n\t\t\t<corner enabled=\"1\">_default</corner>\n\t\t\t<corner enabled=\"1\">tt\n\t\t\t\t<vars>\n\t\t\t\t\t<var>C\n\t\t\t\t\t\t<value>1u</value>\n\t\t\t\t\t</var>\n\t\t\t\t</vars>\n\t\t\t</corner>\n\t\t</corners>\n\t\t<tests>\n\t\t\t<test>tran\n\t\t\t\t<tool>ADE</tool>\n\t\t\t\t<tooloptions>\n\t\t\t\t\t<option>cell\n\t\t\t\t\t\t<value>tb</value>\n\t\t\t\t\t</option>\n\t\t\t\t\t<option>lib\n\t\t\t\t\t\t<value>sfya_rc</value>\n\t\t\t\t\t</option>\n\t\t\t\t\t<option>sim\n\t\t\t\t\t\t<value>spectre</value>\n\t\t\t\t\t</option>\n\t\t\t\t\t<option>view\n\t\t\t\t\t\t<value>schematic</value>\n\t\t\t\t\t</option>\n\t\t\t\t\t<option>path\n\t\t\t\t\t\t<value>$AXL_SETUPDB_DIR</value>\n\t\t\t\t\t</option>\n\t\t\t\t\t<option>state\n\t\t\t\t\t\t<value>active</value>\n\t\t\t\t\t</option>\n\t\t\t\t</tooloptions>\n\t\t\t\t<origoptions>\n\t\t\t\t\t<option>cell\n\t\t\t\t\t\t<value>tb</value>\n\t\t\t\t\t</option>\n\t\t\t\t\t<option>lib\n\t\t\t\t\t\t<value>sfya_rc</value>\n\t\t\t\t\t</option>\n\t\t\t\t\t<option>sim\n\t\t\t\t\t\t<value>spectre</value>\n\t\t\t\t\t</option>\n\t\t\t\t\t<option>view\n\t\t\t\t\t\t<value>schematic</value>\n\t\t\t\t\t</option>\n\t\t\t\t</origoptions>\n\t\t\t</test>\n\t\t</tests>\n\t\t<vars>\n\t\t\t<var>C\n\t\t\t\t<value>1u</value>\n\t\t\t</var>\n\t\t\t<var>R\n\t\t\t\t<value>3.3k</value>\n\t\t\t</var>\n\t\t</vars>\n\t\t<specs>\n\t\t\t<spec>tran.v1m\n\t\t\t\t<testname>tran</testname>\n\t\t\t\t<resname>v1m</resname>\n\t\t\t\t<specType>range</specType>\n\t\t\t\t<min>0.3</min>\n\t\t\t\t<max>0.9</max>\n\t\t\t\t<target></target>\n\t\t\t\t<tol></tol>\n\t\t\t</spec>\n\t\t</specs>\n\t</active>\n</setupdb>\n"
  vmaefiles 5215c4414bcb8007

inst 0aaaaa ./res
  at 0 0 R0
  name R1
  R R
inst 0aaaab ./cap
  at 0 90 R0
  name C1
  C C

wire 0ccccc 0 30 0 60

label 0bbbba 0 -30 R0 in
label 0bbbbb 0 30 R0 out
label 0bbbbd 0 120 R0 0

text 0eeeee -60 -80 R0 "RC low-pass: V1 in 0 1 (code block), tau = R C"
  size 0.3

prose 0ddddd
  | # RC low-pass
  |
  | A 1 V step charges $C$ through $R$: $v_{out} = 1 - e^{-t/\tau}$ with $\tau = RC$.
  |
  | ```plot
  | v(out)
  | ```

var R 3.3k
  unit Ohm
  min 100
  max 10k
var C 1u
  unit F

corner tt
  set C 1u

optimize fit
  algo nelder-mead
  goal tau target 1m
  vary R
  budget 12

output tau "cross(v(out), 0.6321205588285577)"
output v1m "at(v(out), 1m)"

spec v1m
  min 0.3
  max 0.9

code tran spice
  | V1 in 0 1
  | .ic v(out)=0
  | .op
  | .tran 1u 5m 0 1u uic
